summary: Align cross-sync SOP commands with the local CLI

delivery.outcome: Make every command declared by sop-cross-sync executable by the local CLI, preserve dry-run-by-default behavior, add module invocation and deterministic contract tests, then publish through validator-agent.
nonGoals: Add network access, organization-wide synchronization, or external side effects
Change the SOP schema or other canonical procedures
Implement Dual-LLM orchestration, packaging metadata, or a release

architecture.decision: Keep the existing local runtime command vocabulary as canonical: --root selects the target scope, patch is dry-run preflight, sync --write is the only write operation, and JSON is the sole output format. Add sop.__main__ so the procedure's python -m sop invocation works after installation.
interfaceChanges: sop-cross-sync commands use the runtime's supported --root and sync --write interface
The installed package supports python -m sop
architecture.rollback: Discard the unmerged ticket branch and retain the previous specification and CLI.
